paragraphs.text: Grace P. Fong (a.k.a. "Fictograph") is a Narrative Designer from Vancouver, Canada. Since June 2020, she works at Wizards of the Coast where she specializes in art writing.

Her first visible contribution was the Innistrad: Midnight Hunt legends update. Outside of her dayjob, Fong is a four times Hugo-nominated and Ignyte-winning illustrator and concept artist. She makes covers for speculative fiction publications and promotional material for authors. She also has ten years of technical experience in the video game and animation industries (DreamWorks Animation, Infinity Ward, Electronic Arts).
